summary: Tested the Application Preview review popup (backend and UI) for tenant ZELIX VENTURES (DB test_database_t_8286d28c6b04042a). I seeded TEST_app_1..4 directly into students. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass. pending-applications is newest first with no _id; inbox new_applications equals the pending count; staff gets 403 on list and review (and the DB is unchanged); 'maybe' returns 422; unknown id returns 404; reason over 500 chars returns 422. Approve keeps status 'inquiry' and sets application_review {status:'approved', by, by_name, at}. Reject sets 'cancelled' and appends '\n[Application rejected] <reason>' to the existing notes; reject without a reason leaves notes unchanged. UI as admin (1920x1080): hero-inbox-applications count 3 opens applications-review-dialog with cards in order 3,2,1. Each card shows name, course · college, phone, email, city, 'Referred by' and the submitted time. The toggle expands the details (contrast is fine). PDF downloads 'TEST Applicant 3 - Application - <date>.pdf' with no errors. Approve and Confirm reject (with a reason) remove the card, and the hero count drops to 1 and then 0. Open goes to /students/TEST_app_1 and closes the dialog. The empty state shows 'You're all caught up'. Regression: hero-inbox-reminders goes to /leads, hero-inbox-messages goes to /messages, topbar-search is absent, there are no console errors after login, and the mobile 390px layout stacks the 3 inbox cards without horizontal overflow. Found 1 functional gap (office_admin cannot reach the popup) and 2 minor issues.

minor.issue: No guard against re-reviewing: an already approved or rejected application can be reviewed again, and application_review is overwritten. Consider 409 when application_review exists, or allow it on purpose.
Docstring still says 'new applications (7 days)', but it now counts PENDING_APP_FILTER, with no time window. Also, non-admins get new_applications counts they can't act on.

ui_bugs.issue: office_admin is routed to <OfficeDashboard/>, which does not render HeroInbox or ApplicationsReviewDialog. So office admins cannot approve or reject from the Overview, even though the requirement (and the backend) allows office_admin.

The reason state is not cleared on Cancel. If you click Reject, type a reason, click Cancel and then Approve, the stale reason is sent and saved (verified: application_review.reason='stale reason' on an approved app). Clear reason on Cancel, or send reason only for 'rejected'.

integration_issues.issue: The specific toasts ('<name> marked as reviewed' / '<name> rejected') never show. The global axios celebration interceptor (lib/api.js maybeCelebrate) shows a generic 'Saved successfully!' overlay, and celebrate.js suppresses the following toast.success. Consider adding customFor() wording for /dashboard/applications/*/review (e.g. 'Application approved' / 'Application rejected'), or pass skipCelebration so the toast shows.

SuperAdminDashboard (and therefore HeroInbox) also renders for role 'user' without linked_client_id. For them, pending-applications returns 403, and the dialog's catch sets items=[], so it shows 'You're all caught up' while the card count shows N>0. Hide the applications card for non-admins, or show an error state.

action_items: HIGH: Render HeroInbox (or at least the applications card + ApplicationsReviewDialog) on OfficeDashboard so office_admin can review from the Overview.
Clear the reject reason on Cancel, or only send reason when decision === 'rejected'.
Give the review mutation specific success wording (customFor in lib/api.js) instead of the generic 'Saved successfully!' overlay.
Hide or disable the 'New applications' card for non-admin roles that can reach SuperAdminDashboard, or show an error instead of the empty state on 403.
Optional: return 409 when re-reviewing an already reviewed application; fix the inbox docstring.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.py: PENDING_APP_FILTER is defined after inbox() uses it. That works at runtime but is fragile; move it above inbox().
pending-applications caps at to_list(100) while inbox counts everything, so the counts can disagree beyond 100.
There is no office scoping: an office_admin would see all tenant applications. This is fine if 'company admins' is intended.
ApplicationsReviewDialog load() swallows every error into an empty list, so network or 403 errors look like 'all caught up'.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all requested flows work; office_admin access gap, stale reason, generic success feedback)

test_credentials: admin@educonnect.app/Admin@12345 (super_admin) and TEST_att_staff_1@educonnect.app/Staff@12345 (staff), both in tenant DB test_database_t_8286d28c6b04042a. Both valid.
seed_data_creation: Inserted TEST_app_1..4 into test_database_t_8286d28c6b04042a.students (pytest fixture plus /tmp/seed.js for the UI). All deleted afterwards; the pytest fixture also cleans up on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the new test with `pytest test_iteration9_app_review.py -n 0` from /app/backend/tests. pytest.ini enables xdist, which breaks the module-scoped seed fixture. The tenant DB is test_database_t_8286d28c6b04042a; the staff email is stored lowercase. Successful POSTs show a full-screen 'Saved successfully!' celebration overlay, not a sonner toast. The product tour did not appear. On mobile, a 'Skip for now' PIN dialog may appear.
rca of the issue: Office admin gap: Dashboard() returns <OfficeDashboard/> for office_admin before SuperAdminDashboard, and only SuperAdminDashboard renders <HeroInbox/>. Missing toast: lib/api.js maybeCelebrate fires a celebration on every successful POST, and celebrate.js overrides toast.success to return early if recentlyCelebrated(), so the dialog's toast.success is dropped. Stale reason: AppCard keeps the `reason` state after the Cancel button sets rejecting=false, and review('approved') posts { decision, reason }.
